title: fix(driver-sql): a MySQL TEXT column carries its declared literal default
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-alice"} -->
_Requested by **Alice** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePH?thread=cmsg_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePHNLN2yiafBSuB9mbEEMnRSB)_
Fixes #37320

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在 MySQL 上，给已有数据的表新增一个带默认值的必填长文本字段后，旧记录读到的是声明的默认值，不再是空串；不填这个字段的新增也能照常保存。PostgreSQL 和 SQLite 不变。
- 为什么做：主干 CI 的实测 PG + MySQL 一项自上一个加列修复合入后每次都失败，挡住所有改到 SQL 驱动的改动；根因是 MySQL 的长文本列从来没有带上声明的默认值。
- 出错会怎样：只影响 MySQL 上新建或新增的长文本列的默认值；之前建好的表保持原样，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **Root cause.** knex's MySQL column compiler drops every DEFAULT on a `text` builder (its `defaultTo` returns an empty string for a text/blob type, a raw expression included), and MySQL refuses a *literal* DEFAULT on a TEXT column anyway (`ER_BLOB_CANT_HAVE_DEFAULT`). So since the ADD COLUMN change for #37258, `added_dflt` (`type: 'text'`, `storage.notNull`, `defaultValue: 'd'`) was added to the populated MySQL table as `text not null` with no DEFAULT. MySQL then gives existing rows the implicit `''`, and an insert that omits the column is refused (`Field 'added_dflt' doesn't have a default value`). Those are the two red cases. Postgres keeps the DEFAULT, which is why its half passed.
- **MySQL can honour the case.** Measured on MySQL 8.0.46 (the `mysql:8.0` image the CI job uses): `ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN a text not null default ('d')` on a populated table gives the existing row `d`, and an insert that omits `a` stores `d`. The expression form needs MySQL 8.0.13+ / MariaDB 10.2+, the floor `nowColumnDefault` already states for its `time`/`date` defaults.
- `createColumn` (`sql-driver-column-creation.ts`): the two unbounded-text sites (an unbounded `string`-family field, and an unkeyed text-family field) build the column through `specificType(name, 'text')` on MySQL when the field declares a literal default, so knex keeps the clause, and ask `applyDeclaredColumnDefault` for the expression form. Same physical type (`text`). `NOW()` on a text column keeps the old behaviour (no DEFAULT): `nowColumnDefault` has no text-column expression on MySQL.
- `applyDeclaredColumnDefault` (`sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`) takes an `expressionForm` flag and emits `knex.raw('(?)', [dv])`, so the literal is escaped by the client as before. `SqlDriver#applyDeclaredColumnDefault` passes it through and gives the body `knex`. `sql-driver.ts` stays at its line ceiling (10071).
- `physicalDefaultLiteral` (`schema-drift.ts`): MySQL reports that DEFAULT as the charset-introduced, backslash-escaped `_utf8mb4\'d\'` (`EXTRA = DEFAULT_GENERATED`). Read as a bare literal, it compared unequal to the declaration. The live run of the new drift case showed `set_column_default:added_dflt` proposed against the column that had just been created. The statement that applies that op is refused on a TEXT column (`ALTER COLUMN … SET DEFAULT`, the parenthesised form too, measured `ER_BLOB_CANT_HAVE_DEFAULT`). The spelling is now read as an expression, like every other physical expression, and neither literal arm acts on it.

## Tests

- `sql-driver-37258-add-column-not-null.test.ts`: the two MySQL cases pass unchanged. New case on every cell: "reports no drift for the column that took its declared literal default". It is red on MySQL without the `schema-drift.ts` reading.
- `sql-driver-36245-stale-literal-default.test.ts`: two rows in the physical-DEFAULT table pin the MySQL spelling as `expression`, on every run, including CI runs with no live server.

## Acceptance notes

- **How CI measures the live leg.** `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` never runs on `pull_request`. Its `if:` reads `github.event_name != 'pull_request'`, so it runs on push/schedule and in the merge queue when the entry's diff hits the `temporal_live` paths. This PR's own check-runs therefore do not carry it. The live evidence above is local, from the same images and settings. The queue build of this PR is the first CI measurement. No workflow file is touched.
- A MySQL table an earlier release created keeps its TEXT columns without a DEFAULT. The differ leaves "no physical DEFAULT under a declared one" alone, as it did before. Writes through the engine still store the declared default there.
- Residual, same family, not changed here: a text field declaring `defaultValue: 'NOW()'` on MySQL still gets no column DEFAULT (knex drops `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` on TEXT, and a bare one is refused). Also, the MySQL `relax_not_null`/`tighten_not_null` arms restate a column through `MODIFY` without its DEFAULT. Neither is reached by this card's cases.

## Verification

Read first: `sql-driver-column-creation.ts` (`textColumn` and the `mysqlTextDefault` flag at the head of the type switch), then `schema-drift.ts` (`MYSQL_INTRODUCED_STRING` in `physicalDefaultLiteral`).

Two-minute check: start `mysql:8.0` and run `OS_TEST_MYSQL_URL=mysql://root:root@127.0.0.1:3306/conformance pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-37258-add-column-not-null.test.ts`. Expect 12 passed: 6 on sqlite and 6 on live mysql.

  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure`: they read every package's `dist/`, and only the driver-sql closure is built here.
- `--ran` with exit codes: `73 derived, 70 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED (3 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3), 0 UNRUN`.
- `check:facade-delegation-only`: `sql-driver.ts: 10071 lines, ceiling 10071`. `check:nul-bytes`: OK.
